programme.title: North
programme.desc: North (Elijah Wood) is a talented and bright kid, but his mom (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) and dad (Jason Alexander) are utterly preoccupied with other things in their lives, leaving him largely ignored. Advised by a mysterious man (Bruce Willis) who pops up on occasion, North decides to legally separate himself from his parents and goes on a search across the globe for the ideal mother and father. Unfortunately for the young boy, most of the people that he meets have very little potential. (Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-07-22

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers, Andy (Justin Kelly) and Mark (Benjamin Stockham), learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island but vanished without a trace, taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2016-02-22

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2006-09-29

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies. (Biography, Movie, Music, Rock) - 1978-05-18

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1998-07-17

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights. (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2005-10-28

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

programme.title: The Baby-Sitters Club
programme.desc: Kristy Thomas and her six best friends struggle to make their successful business -- the Baby-Sitters Club -- into a full-fledged summer day camp. When a group of adults led by their crotchety neighbor, Emily Haberman, tries to shut down the camp, the girls must band together to keep their dream alive. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy. (Children, Drama, Movie) - 1995-08-18

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds. (Children, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1982-05-20

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz). (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2011-01-14

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 1999-09-17

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies. (Biography, Movie, Music, Rock) - 1978-05-18

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly-fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going. (Drama, Movie) - 1992-09-13

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: On the way to a tryout with the Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-05-11

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison. (Action, Movie) - 1975-05-22

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck. (Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1977-06-17

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: On the planet of Krull, an evil creature called the Beast decimates the world's army and kidnaps the lovely Princess Lyssa, who is destined to become queen. Her brave beau, Prince Colwyn, leads a motley band of warriors, including Ergo and Kegan, to rescue his beloved. However, before he can face the Beast, Colwyn must locate a mystical weapon known as the Glaive, which he can use to slay the hideous villain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1983-07-29

programme.title: Dinosaur With Stephen Fry - Dawn Of The Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Stephen Fry is transported 155 million years back in time to the first Golden Age of the dinosaurs, the Jurassic, when they grew into giants. He explores the conifer forests and fern prairies that were their home, to encounter a monstrous plant-eating Diplodocus, and a deadly predator, the Allosaurus. Expert Dr Susie Maidment, from London's Natural History Museum, arrives to help decode these dinosaurs' remarkable behaviour. (Documentary)

programme.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
programme.desc: With archival footage and access to unclassified CIA documents, The Cuban Missile Crisis takes you on a journey, from the beginnings of the Cold War right up to its peak in 1962, when the world nearly faced nuclear destruction. A compelling tale of geopolitical tension, diplomacy and the quest for power. (Documentary)

programme.title: SBS World News - Sbs World News 2026 Ep 325 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

programme.title: Royals And Their Gardens - Audley End House And Gardens
programme.desc: Audley End House, a Jacobean mansion built to impress King James I, became the centre of scandal when its owner, Thomas Howard, was jailed for embezzlement. Later a royal retreat under Charles II and a WWII spy base, the estate has seen royal drama, financial ruin, and espionage. Today, with gardens by Capability Brown and interiors by Robert Adam, it stands as a grand relic of England's aristocratic legacy. (Documentary)

programme.title: The Three Kings Of 1936 - Three Kings Of 1936, The
